Inventory written to `operations/engineering/records/sessions/research/process-ontology-inventory.log`.

**What it covers** (120+ files across 17 categories):

1. **9 core ideas** — unified record sketch, all-records-as-transactions, MUD chat messaging, double-entry accounting, chart of accounts, graph-as-composition, dual-cone architecture, relational expression syntax, live-swap components
2. **1 decision record** — convergence through minimum viable instance (561d IS the MUD/ERP/CMS/OS)
3. **10 projects** — relational computer (4 systems), relational MUD, relational OS, work operations, flatfile/local/distributed systems, library-as-KB, generative harness, charter/governance
4. **~20 plans** — ops loop stages, consumption plans for 7 prior computer models, FARS extraction, foundational ontology research, charter predication
5. **5 core math texts** — predication paper, predication-as-residuation, bilattice tutorial, lattice-to-residuated, nuclear functions
6. **5 process philosophy texts + 19 terms** — actual occasions, prehension, concrescence, creativity, societies, plus the full Whiteheadian vocabulary
7. **28 foundational ontology terms** — thing, act, event, relation, change, state, quality, object, container, vessel, property, time, identity, etc.
8. **5 philosophy surveys** — action/change, state/time/event, relation/identity, quality/property, totality/mereology
9. **5 MUD architecture files** — the MUD-as-system-architecture text, LPMud, mudlibs, world-building-as-programming
10. **8 cybernetics terms** — feedback, autopoiesis, VSM, requisite variety, second-order cybernetics
11. **8 semiotics terms** — sign, semiosis, habit, interpretant, Peirce's categories
12. **Large triage body** — semiotic universe, GFRTU, cellular computation, interactive semioverse, relational entity/operation/state terms
13. **Older planning ideas** — event-stream record spec (6 files), process-ontology-and-classification investigation, emsemioverse engine, hypertensor topos machine spec, Petri nets, closure-operators-as-API-contracts

The synthesis section at the end ties it all together: a unified record is a Whiteheadian actual occasion, the system is a MUD, records are the atoms of every view, and the bilattice/fiber math is what makes it precise rather than metaphorical.
